entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I'm going to assume it's not good.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: I'm going to send a quarantine unit down to get you, agent Doggett, okay? I want you to stay right where you are.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I appreciate it, agent Scully but I can't do that. If we're going to stop the spread of this thing I got to stop lieutenant bianco.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Dr. Bowe, I need you to get on the phone with the CDC. Tell them everything we know. We have to learn as quickly as possible what sets this thing off. Look... I need you to blockade any and every exit from the system. You've got a possible outbreak situation here.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: No, no. That's not going to happen.
entries.speaker: Deputy Chief Karras

entries.text: No, you listen to me. Your lieutenant is infected and at large in the system and he is looking for a way out.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I hear you. It's just that there are already passengers waiting on the platform.
entries.speaker: Deputy Chief Karras

entries.text: Agent Doggett... We've got a new wrinkle.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Don't tell me.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: We're running out of time. It's 20 to 4:00.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I'm moving as fast as I can.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Agent Doggett, you shouldn't be moving at all.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: In 20 minutes I'll be taking a long bath at the hotel. Right now, I got to find this guy.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: This organism that's on your skin-- something triggers it, and I don't know what. It could be body temperature. It could be heart rate.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: It could be from standing still, too, right? Maybe the only thing keeping me from sparking up right now is that I'm moving.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Yeah, I guess you're right.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I'm getting out of this thing, agent Scully. Just make sure karras holds those trains till I find bianco.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: He's got passengers waiting at the next station.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You tell that son of a bitch he's got to clear the system. He's... Wait. I see something. Lieutenant... He's hurt.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: You see this, dr. Bowe? You see this, mr. Karras? You're on with the CDC? I need anything they can give me about what sets this organism off-- an idea, a notion, a wild guess.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Agent Scully what do you want me to do?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Get out of there agent Doggett.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: What about this man?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: I'm going to send a haz-mat team down for him but from what I've seen the reaction's progressive.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Please, agent Doggett don't leave me.
entries.speaker: Lt. Bianco

entries.text: I hope you're enjoying the ride. You see this, agent Scully?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Yeah.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Who else is down there?
entries.speaker: Dr. Bowe

entries.text: We don't know. You, there! Stop! Federal agent! I'm armed! Agent Scully, believe this? Who are you? What's your name? What are you doing down here?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: What's he pointing at?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I don't know.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Is he infected?
entries.speaker: Dr. Bowe

entries.text: Agent Doggett, turn the light away.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Nothing. He's unaffected.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: How's that?
entries.speaker: Dr. Bowe

entries.text: I think I just figured it out. I might know what triggers this.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: What is it?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Sweat. Perspiration is a conductor for calcium ions promoting a chemical-electrical reaction.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Electricity?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: That's right. And since the boy's sweat glands aren't fully developed then he wouldn't be as conductive.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Just my luck.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Agent Doggett, where's he going?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I don't know but he wants me to follow him. Agent Scully, I don't know if you can see this. I think I found the source of the contagion. It looks like a big leak in the ceiling is crumbling the walls flooding into the system. It must have seeped in from the bay. Hey, where you going? You see this? The kid's walking right through this stuff.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Yeah. I'm... I'm checking my graphic here. It... It looks like he's trying to lead you through to a tunnel on the main system. And, if what I'm looking at is accurate it would put you about 400 yards from an access point. I mean, if I could put a haz-mat team together we might be able to have you out in about 15 minutes.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Come on, lieutenant. We're in through to the main system, agent Scully and we got big, big problems here.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Yes, we do.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You see this flooding?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: No. It's worse than that. I think this moron karras has started the trains rolling.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ train whistle blowing ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ whistle blowing ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Agent Doggett what are you doing? Agent Doggett... Get off the tracks, agent Doggett. Get out of there!
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: We got people on the train. They could get infected.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Get out of there, agent Doggett!
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Let me have this. Give it to me! Give it to me! I got an idea, agent Scully.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Agent Doggett? Talk to me, agent Doggett.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ electrical crackling ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Agent Doggett? Are you there? Can you hear me?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Yeah. Yeah, I'm here.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Thank god. Uh... I lost you on the visual. Okay... Okay, I've got you. You're back. Are you okay?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I can only hope, agent Scully.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: [ clicking ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Nurse! Nurse!
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Where do you think you're going?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Find the nurse. She said she was going to talk to the doctor about me going home. I could be dying in here for all she knows.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Well, you're not... Agent Doggett. Your skin and body have been rid of the organism. Simple alcohol bath cleaned you right up. I was just down talking to the nurse and I told her I'd come and give you the news.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Well, can I get out of here?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Yes.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: What about the others?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Well, the kid is with social services and plastic surgeons are working on melnick and bianco and dr. Lyle has been discharged.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You know, I'd like to think that this was over but there's going to be hell to pay for these guys.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: No. It's over, agent Doggett.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Excuse me? This guy karras put a train back on the tracks. He recklessly endangered people's lives.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: But there is no proof of that.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: What do you mean, there's no proof?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: What I'm saying is that the organism is no longer extant. It's destroyed.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: By what?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: I'm guessing by the electrical charge that you set off.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: We have victims. Dead bodies.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Infected by a pathogen of unknown etiology. Look, agent Doggett not a criminal charge is going to stick. These guys were just doing their job-- keeping the trains running. But they've got you to thank. And not just for saving their butts.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: No. You figured it out. I was just your eyes and ears. Agent Scully...
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Let's go home.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
